verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד יְהוָ֥ה רֹ֝עִ֗י לֹ֣א אֶחְסָֽר׃
verses.literal: A Psalm of David The LORD is my shepherd I shall not want
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR é o meu pastor, nada me faltará.

verses.original: בִּנְא֣וֹת דֶּ֭שֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵ֑נִי עַל־ מֵ֖י מְנֻח֣וֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: bin·’ō·wṯ de·še yar·bî·ṣê·nî ‘al- mê mə·nu·ḥō·wṯ yə·na·hă·lê·nî
verses.literal: He makes me lie down in green pastures He leads me beside quiet waters
verses.literalPt: Deitar-me faz em verdes pastos, guia-me mansamente a águas tranqüilas.

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֥י יְשׁוֹבֵ֑ב יַֽנְחֵ֥נִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי־ צֶ֝֗דֶק לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî yə·šō·w·ḇêḇ yan·ḥê·nî ḇə·ma‘·gə·lê- ṣe·ḏeq lə·ma·‘an šə·mōw
verses.literal: He restores my soul He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name
verses.literalPt: Refrigera a minha alma; guia-me pelas veredas da justiça, por amor do seu nome.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם כִּֽי־ אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּגֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא־ אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי־ אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑י שִׁבְטְךָ֥ וּ֝מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: gam kî- ’ê·lêḵ bə·ḡê ṣal·mā·weṯ lō- ’î·rā rā‘ kî- ’at·tāh ‘im·mā·ḏî šiḇ·ṭə·ḵā ū·miš·‘an·te·ḵā hêm·māh yə·na·ḥă·mu·nî
verses.literal: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death I will fear no evil for You are with me Your rod and Your staff they comfort me
verses.literalPt: Ainda que eu andasse pelo vale da sombra da morte, não temeria mal algum, porque tu estás comigo; a tua vara e o teu cajado me consolam.

verses.original: תַּעֲרֹ֬ךְ לְפָנַ֨י׀ שֻׁלְחָ֗ן נֶ֥גֶד צֹרְרָ֑י דִּשַּׁ֖נְתָּ בַשֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י כּוֹסִ֥י רְוָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·rōḵ lə·p̄ā·nay šul·ḥān ne·ḡeḏ ṣō·rə·rāy diš·šan·tā ḇaš·še·men rō·šî kō·w·sî rə·wā·yāh
verses.literal: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies You anoint my head with oil my cup overflows
verses.literalPt: Preparas uma mesa perante mim na presença dos meus inimigos, unges a minha cabeça com óleo, o meu cálice transborda.

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ׀ ט֤וֹב וָחֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפוּנִי כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְּבֵית־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ṭō·wḇ wā·ḥe·seḏ yir·də·p̄ū·nî kāl- yə·mê ḥay·yāy wə·šaḇ·tî bə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh lə·’ō·reḵ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Certamente que a bondade e a misericórdia me seguirão todos os dias da minha vida; e habitarei na casa do SENHOR por longos dias.
